findings.claim: Do not use mutable env.PWD as authoritative final cwd.
findings.layer: Public BashShell API and next command
findings.evidence: dogfood.log:6-84,215-217. PWD=/tmp; pwd prints /home/user then changes next execution to /tmp. cd /tmp; unset PWD; pwd and local-PWD function lose the actual cd. Base preserves actual directory for all three. Obtain authoritative execution cwd without replaying user input.

findings.claim: Normalize relative initial cwd before passing it to exec and completion.
findings.evidence: dogfood.log:140-149,177-185,218. cwd='home/user', files={'/home/user/homefile':'HOME'}: after pwd, base cwd=/home/user and cat home<Tab> appends file. Head cwd=home/user and Tab appends nothing; directory is resolved relative to itself.

findings.claim: Keep the default shell out of a nonexistent working directory.
findings.layer: Default constructor and repeated public command execution
findings.evidence: dogfood.log:151-169,187-205,219. new BashShell(); pwd; ls; ls: base reports missing /home/user then recovers to / and both ls succeed. Head claims /home/user and both ls fail. files={} suppresses dependency default layout, and ExecOptions.cwd does not create or validate that directory.
